section_summary.extract_value: This section details the analytic strategy for a daily diary study, employing multilevel modeling to analyze hierarchical data. It describes the disaggregation and centering of predictor variables into within- and between-persons variance, and outlines four multilevel models run in SAS 9.3. BMI was included as a covariate, while intuitive eating, body appreciation, body image concerns, and negative affect served as criteria variables.
